title: Japanese Law Article Text
description: Law name + article number per query. A query with only a law name returns the article list. Every result row is charged, including not-found rows.

queries.title: Queries
queries.description: e.g. 民法第709条, 民法第90条の2第1項, 個人情報保護法第27条, 会社法. Kanji or Arabic numerals both work; official abbreviations (個人情報保護法) are resolved.

asOf.title: As of date (optional)
asOf.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Returns the version of the law that was in force on that date (point-in-time). Leave empty for the current version.
